response.overview: In an effort to change his family’s fate, a father named Bima makes a black magic pact that brings instant wealth. However, that prosperity comes at a high price when their relatives begin dying under mysterious circumstances. His daughter, Kirana, slowly realizes that the wealth they’ve been enjoying comes from the blood sacrifice of their own family, and that the curse now flows through their bloodline. Haunted by supernatural forces demanding fulfillment of the pact, Kirana—with the help of her older brother Galang and two friends—embarks on a perilous journey to break the pact. They are faced with a final choice: loyalty to their family or risking their own lives.
response.title: Tarian Iblis
